Subject: [{{{org_name}}}] Your application draft is waiting
Hello {{{contact_first_name}}},
Just a gentle reminder — the application draft for {{{org_name}}} hasn't been updated since {{{last_activity_date}}}. Everything you entered is saved and secure.

Resume your application here: {{{rfi_link}}}
Not planning to continue? Simply ignore this email or reply to let us know.
